title: A.S. Krishna v. State of Madras

content.caseIdentity: A.S. Krishna v. State of Madras, AIR 1957 SC 297
content.holding: Laid down the comprehensive criteria for ascertaining pith and substance: objects, scheme, substantive effects, and extent of encroachment.
content.relevance: Standard judicial metric for testing true character of statutes.
